info.name: Sprint 1 — Ingestion Gateway (einvoice-platform)
info.description:
ERP-facing ingestion endpoints for ETA Receipts/Invoices and ZATCA Standard/Simplified invoices.

**Base URL variable:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:8080`).

All requests are unauthenticated in Sprint 1 (`permitAll()` on `/api/integration/v1/**`). API-key auth lands in Sprint 2.

Each folder contains a happy-path example plus relevant conditional variants (credit notes, anonymous buyer, etc.). Request descriptions document which fields are optional vs. conditionally required.

variable.description: ZATCA-registered company VAT number (15 digits, starts with 3)
SANDBOX or PREPROD. PRODUCTION is intentionally rejected.

item.name: POST ETA Receipt — happy path (B2C, walk-in customer)

request.description:
Creates an ETA Receipt. Aligned to ETA Receipt SDK v1.2.

**Required gateway routing fields:** `companyRegistrationNumber`, `environment`, `status`. `erpReferenceId` is optional.

**Conditional fields (not in this example):**
- `header.exchangeRate` — required when `currency != EGP`
- `header.referenceOldUUID` — set when referencing a previous receipt
- `buyer.id` + `buyer.name` — required when `buyer.type = B`, or when `buyer.type = P` and `totalAmount >= 150000 EGP`
- `extraReceiptDiscountData[]` — optional list of header-level discounts
- `contractor`, `beneficiary` — optional
- Item-level: `commercialDiscountData[]`, `itemDiscountData[]`, `additionalCommercialDiscount`, `additionalItemDiscount`, `valueDifference`

**SDK-reserved fields:** `feesAmount`, `adjustment` must be `0`.

**Status values:** DRAFT | VALID | INVALID | CLEARED | REPORTED | REJECTED | FAILED | CANCELLED

Creates an ETA Invoice. Based on ETA Invoice SDK v1.0.

**Optional fields not shown:** `serviceDeliveryDate`, `taxpayerActivityCode`, `purchaseOrderReference`, `salesOrderReference`, `proformaInvoiceNumber`, `etaUuid`, `etaLongId`, `etaSubmissionId`, address optional sub-fields (`postalCode`, `floor`, `room`, `landmark`, `additionalInformation`).

**Conditional fields:**
- `originalInvoiceNumber` — required when `documentType` is `C` (credit) or `D` (debit). See the next request for an example.
- `lines[].unitValue.currencyExchangeRate` — required when `currencySold != EGP`.

**Document types:** I (Invoice) | C (Credit note) | D (Debit note).

request.description:
Credit-note variant. `documentType = C` triggers the service-layer rule that `originalInvoiceNumber` must be present, otherwise `MissingOriginalDocumentException` → HTTP 400 `MISSING_ORIGINAL_DOCUMENT`.

The service resolves `originalInvoiceNumber` to a UUID (`originalDocumentId` FK) when a matching invoice exists in the same `(company, environment)`; otherwise the raw string is stored only in the `originalInvoiceNumber` column (hybrid resolution per resolved decision Q5).

item.name: POST ZATCA Standard — happy path (B2B clearance)

request.description:
Creates a ZATCA Standard (B2B) invoice. `buyer` is **required** for Standard.

**`transactionTypeCode` regex:** `1[01]{5}0000` (bit 1 = 1 → Standard).

**Optional fields not shown:** `supplyDate`, `supplyEndDate`, `taxCurrency`, `prepaidAmount`, address sub-fields (`citySubdivisionName`, `postalZone`, `additionalStreetName`, `plotIdentification`).

**Populated only after clearance (echo-back scenarios):** `invoiceCounterValue`, `previousInvoiceHash`, `invoiceHash`, `qrCodeBase64`, `clearanceStatus`.

**Conditional:**
- `originalInvoiceNumber` — required when `invoiceTypeCode` is `381` (credit) or `383` (debit). See next request.
- `lines[].exemptionReasonCode` + `exemptionReasonText` — required when `vatCategoryCode` is `E` or `O`.

item.name: POST ZATCA Simplified — anonymous B2C (no buyer)

request.description:
Creates a ZATCA Simplified (B2C) invoice for an anonymous walk-in customer (no `buyer` object).

**Differences vs. Standard:**
- `transactionTypeCode` regex: `0[01]{5}0000` (bit 1 = 0 → Simplified)
- `buyer` is **optional** — can be omitted, sent as `null`, or sent as a partial object
- Status field after submission is `reportingStatus` (not `clearanceStatus`)

**Conditional:** same as Standard — `originalInvoiceNumber` required for `invoiceTypeCode` 381/383; exemption reasons required for `vatCategoryCode` E/O.

item.name: POST ZATCA Simplified — with named buyer + exempt line

request.description:
Simplified invoice that exercises two optional shapes at once:
1. A partial `buyer` object (allowed because Simplified buyer is optional).
2. An exempt VAT line — `vatCategoryCode = E` requires both `exemptionReasonCode` and `exemptionReasonText`; missing either triggers `VAT_EXEMPTION_REASON_REQUIRED` (HTTP 400).
